note: Fits the physical half of the ICP almost perfectly and fails the commercial half. He is 59, 6'3", 209 lb, trains four to five mornings a week and has for five years, and wants to shed roughly twenty pounds — the definition of good-to-great and the opposite of the fifty-pounds-overweight gym-averse exclusion. But he is a desk employee on a company Zoom account, not a business owner or physician, he arrived with a $2,000-$3,000 ceiling, and he had already left a $300/month gym because it got too expensive. Health is also not the neglected area of his life — it is the area he has been most consistent in; the neglected variable is coaching, not effort. Same shape as the Badrane Hriouch assessment: fits on profile, misses on willingness and capacity to pay.
